items.source: Variant of AbstractMessageConverterMethodProcessor(List, ContentNegotiationManager, List) with additional list of ErrorResponse.Interceptors for return value handling.
items.translation: `AbstractMessageConverterMethodProcessor(List, ContentNegotiationManager, List)` 的变体，带有用于返回值处理的额外 ErrorResponse.Interceptor 列表。

items.source: Create a new HttpOutputMessage from the given NativeWebRequest.
items.translation: 从给定的NativeWebRequest创建一个新的HttpOutputMessage。

items.source: Variant of AbstractMessageConverterMethodProcessor(List, ContentNegotiationManager) with an additional requestResponseBodyAdvice list for return value handling.
items.translation: `AbstractMessageConverterMethodProcessor(List, ContentNegotiationManager)` 的变体，额外包含一个用于返回值处理的 `requestResponseBodyAdvice` 列表。

items.source: Construct with the provided list of converters and ContentNegotiationManager.
items.translation: 使用提供的转换器列表和ContentNegotiationManager进行构建。

items.source: Return whether the returned value or the declared return type extends Resource.
items.translation: 返回该返回值或声明的返回类型是否扩展了Resource。

items.source: Returns the media types that can be produced.
items.translation: 返回可生成的媒体类型。

items.source:
Returns the media types that can be produced. The resulting media types are:
  • The producible media types specified in the request mappings, or
  • Media types of configured converters that can write the specific return value, or
  • MediaType.ALL
items.translation:
返回可生成的媒体类型。生成的媒体类型为：
  • 请求映射中指定的可生成媒体类型，或
  • 能够写入特定返回值的配置转换器的媒体类型，或
  • MediaType.ALL

items.source: Extends AbstractMessageConverterMethodArgumentResolver with the ability to handle method return values by writing to the response with HttpMessageConverters.
items.translation: 继承 `AbstractMessageConverterMethodArgumentResolver`，并具备通过 `HttpMessageConverters` 将方法返回值写入响应流的能力。

items.source: Invoke the configured ErrorResponse.Interceptor's.
items.translation: 调用已配置的ErrorResponse.Interceptor。

items.source: Writes the given return value to the given web request. Delegates to writeWithMessageConverters(Object, MethodParameter, ServletServerHttpRequest, ServletServerHttpResponse)
items.translation: 将给定的返回值写入给定的 Web 请求。委托给 writeWithMessageConverters(Object, MethodParameter, ServletServerHttpRequest, ServletServerHttpResponse)

items.source: Return the type of the value to be written to the response. Typically this is a simple check via getClass on the value but if the value is null, then the return type needs to be examined possibly including generic type determination (for example, ResponseEntity<T>).
items.translation: 返回要写入响应的值的类型。通常，这通过 `getClass` 对值进行简单检查即可完成，但如果值为 null，则需要检查返回类型，可能包括泛型类型的确定（例如 `ResponseEntity<T>`）。

items.source: Construct with the provided list of converters only.
items.translation: 仅使用提供的转换器列表进行构建。

items.source: Write the given return type to the given output message.
items.translation: 将给定的返回类型写入给定的输出消息。

items.source: HttpMediaTypeNotAcceptableException - thrown when the conditions indicated by the Accept header on the request cannot be met by the message converters
items.translation: HttpMediaTypeNotAcceptableException - 当请求中的 Accept 头指示的条件无法由消息转换器满足时抛出。

items.source: inputMessage - the input messages, used to inspect the Accept header
items.translation: inputMessage - 输入消息，用于检查 Accept 标头。

items.source: IOException - thrown in case of I/O errors
items.translation: IOException - 在发生 I/O 错误时抛出

items.source: HttpMessageNotWritableException - thrown if a given message cannot be written by a converter, or if the content-type chosen by the server has no compatible converter.
items.translation: HttpMessageNotWritableException - 在给定消息无法由转换器写入，或服务器选择的 content-type 没有兼容的转换器时抛出。

items.source: webRequest - the web request to create an output message from
items.translation: webRequest - 用于从该 Web 请求创建输出消息的请求。

items.source: value - the value to write to the output message
items.translation: value - 要写入输出消息的值

items.source: returnType - the type of the value
items.translation: returnType - 值的类型

items.source: outputMessage - the output message to write to
items.translation: outputMessage - 要写入的输出消息

items.source: Arjen Poutsma, Rossen Stoyanchev, Brian Clozel, Juergen Hoeller, Sebastien Deleuze
items.translation: Arjen Poutsma, Rossen Stoyanchev, Brian Clozel, Juergen Hoeller, Sebastien Deleuze

items.source: the output message
items.translation: 输出消息

items.source: Return the type of the value to be written to the response.
items.translation: 返回要写入响应的值的类型。

items.source: Writes the given return value to the given web request.
items.translation: 将给定的返回值写入给定的 Web 请求。
